title: The Lucinda Lipol Tour of Provincetown
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Formerly the Anne Hutchinson Tour of Provincetown, Lucinda Liphol has taken over the talking points. Her tongue is so sharp she can't close her mouth! She knows each and every fact old or new and simply can't wait to make you laugh using Provincetown's history. Though routes vary, 2025 tours start in the center of town at Bas Relief Park and are each about an hour in duration and a mile in distance. Offered daily. 20 people maximum on each tour. For a sampling of Lucinda's comedy, find her on social: @lucinda.liphol.
IMPORTANT NOTE: Due to content, this is a tour for people 21 years of age and older. No exceptions. IDs required.
